text: dsh-web-access 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的联网研究插件。它在 DSH 工具接口中注册网页搜索、内容抓取、搜索结果续取和来源核验能力，并可选接入官方 web 搜索与抓取提供方。搜索支持多个可配置服务并可组合查询；抓取可将网页整理为可读内容，也覆盖 GitHub、PDF、YouTube 和本地视频等输入。它还提供搜索工作流命令和 Web 端状态面板，适合需要在 DSH 会话中查找资料、读取网页并核对来源的用户。可用提供方及其密钥按配置选择。

dsh-web-access adds web research tools to the DSH web client, including multi-provider search, page fetching, stored-result retrieval, and source checking. It also handles PDF, GitHub, YouTube, and local video inputs. Commands control summary workflows, and a web panel shows status.
想让 DSH 能调用不同的网页搜索服务查资料
需要在一次研究中用多个角度搜索网页
怎么把网页抓取成适合模型阅读的内容
我想让 DSH 读取 PDF 和 GitHub 仓库内容
能不能根据网页来源核对一个说法
需要从之前的搜索结果里继续查看某段内容
想在 DSH 里切换搜索摘要和人工审核流程
How can I search the web from a DSH session using different providers?
dsh-web-access 的功能「多提供方搜索」：调用 web_search 或 /websearch 发起单个或多个查询，可指定提供方、结果数量和时间范围，并选择摘要工作流。。
dsh-web-access 的功能「网页与媒体提取」：调用 fetch_content 提交 URL 或本地视频路径，获取可读内容；代码也接入 PDF、GitHub 与 YouTube 提取路径。。
dsh-web-access 的功能「续取搜索内容」：使用 get_search_content 和先前响应 ID，按查询或 URL 读取已保存内容，也可按文本查找段落。。
dsh-web-access 的功能「来源核验」：调用 source_check 提交主张和可选搜索条件，生成带来源段落的研究结果并给出支持、反驳或不确定状态。。
dsh-web-access 的功能「搜索流程控制」：通过 /curator 在 none、summary-review 与 auto-summary 等流程间切换；/search 可列出已存搜索和抓取结果。。

English | [中文](#中文)

This plugin ports the [pi-web-access](https://github.com/nicobailon/pi-web-access) product onto dsh:

dsh-web-access README · dsh-web-access：- `web_search` / `web_access_search` with 20+ providers and fallback
- `fetch_content` for pages, GitHub clones, PDFs, YouTube, and local video
- `get_search_content` for stored slices and passage find
- `source_check` for claim verification
- optional `ctx.web` providers so official `web_search` / `web_fetch` can use the same backends
- `/websearch`, `/curator`, `/search`, `/google-account`, `/webaccess`
- Web UI overlay registered on the official `shell.overlay` slot via `dsh.client` (falls back to a script inject if the client graph misses the package)
- Official `card: 'web'` search/fetch cards, background-fetch notices, and image attachments when `ctx.attachments` is present
dsh-web-access README · dsh-web-access：It is an independent plugin. It is not affiliated with DeepSeek AI.

dsh-web-access README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-web-access
```

If the profile already has official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web` `web_search`, this plugin registers as `web_access_search` instead of colliding. Set `replaceOfficialSearch: true` or disable official search to keep the `web_search` name.

```yaml
- id: dsh-web-access
  name: dsh-web-access
  config:
    replaceOfficialSearch: false

To point official tools at this backend:

dsh-web-access README · Install：```yaml
- id: web
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web'
  config:
    searchProvider: web-access

dsh-web-access README · Config：Reads `web-access.json` or the older `web-search.json` from:

1. `$DSH_WEB_ACCESS_DIR`
2. `$PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` (so existing pi-web-access configs just work)
3. `$DSH_HOME`
4. `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dsh` or `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/pi`
5. `~/.dsh` or `~/.pi`

A zero-config Exa / DuckDuckGo / SearXNG setup works the same way as pi-web-access. Add provider keys for more backends.

dsh-web-access README · Tools：```ts
web_search({ query: "TypeScript 5.9 rewriteRelativeImportExtensions" })
web_search({ queries: ["query 1", "query 2"], workflow: "auto-summary" })
fetch_content({ url: "https://docs.example.com/guide" })
fetch_content({ url: "https://github.com/owner/repo" })

dsh-web-access README · Tools：Default workflow is `auto-summary` (generate a summary without opening the curator; deterministic if no summary model is available). `summary-review` opens the HTTP curator and prints a URL. If the curator cannot auto-open a browser, open the printed URL manually.

Provider keys such as `jinaApiKey` / `JINA_API_KEY` enable [Jina Search](https://s.jina.ai) (`jina`). Config example: `"summaryGenerationDeadlineMs": 30000`. `summaryGenerationDeadlineMs` is capped at `600000`.
